tool_description: AutoMorph_preprocess is a Docker-based tool for preprocessing retinal fundus images. It supports resizing and other image normalization steps to prepare data for downstream analysis such as segmentation or classification.

input.description: Path to the input folder containing raw retinal fundus images.

output.description: Path to the output folder where preprocessed images will be saved.

Image_size.description: Resize image to the given square size (e.g., 1024x1024). Optional. If not specified, default internal size will be used.

preprocessed_images.description: Paths to the preprocessed image files saved in the output folder.
